data.name: Imri
data.long_meaning: From the Hebrew language, Imri means ‘God hears.’ It is mentioned in the Old Testament as a name given to King Solomon and a descendant of Aaron. The name signifies God's attentiveness and responsiveness to prayers.

in_hebrew.name: עמרי
in_hebrew.meaning: עמרי - שמי ה' הוא מקור כוחי
in_hebrew.long_meaning: עמרי הוא שם עברי שפירושו 'שמי ה' הוא מקור כוחי' או 'אלוהים הוא מקור כוחי'. השם עמרי מורכב משתי מילים: 'עמר' שפירושו 'להמר' או 'להיות מר', ו'י' שפירושו 'אלוהים'. השם עמרי מוזכר במקרא כבן של עמיקל ומנהיג ישראל בתקופת המלכים.

in_greek.name: Ἰμρί
in_greek.meaning: Ἰμρί - ὁ Θεός ἐστιν ἡ δύναμις
in_greek.long_meaning: Ἰμρί (Imri) σημαίνει 'ὁ Θεός ἐστιν ἡ δύναμις' (ο Θεός είναι η δύναμη) ή 'ἡ Θεία δύναμις' (η Θεία δύναμη). Τὸ ὄνομα Ἰμρί προέχεται ἀπὸ τὴν ἑβραϊκὴ λέξιν 'עמרי' (Imri), ἡ ὁποία ἀναφέρεται σὲ ἕνα τῶν οἰκογενειῶν τῶν Ἰσραηλιτῶν στὴν Παλαιὰ Διαθήκη.

in_latin.name: Imri
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen Imri significat 'Deus est mea virtus' vel 'Deus est fortitudo mea'. Imri est nomen hebraicum quod in Biblia Hebraica invenitur, et est nomen viri qui fuit dux populi Israelitarum in aetate regum.

in_english.name: Imri
in_english.meaning: God is my strength or God is my power
in_english.long_meaning: The name Imri originates from the Hebrew name 'עמרי' (Imri), which means 'God is my strength' or 'God is my power'. It is derived from two Hebrew words: 'Amar' meaning 'to be bitter' or 'to be strong' and 'El' meaning 'God'. In the Bible, Imri is mentioned as the son of Ammishaddai and a leader of the Israelites during the time of the kings. The name Imri symbolizes spiritual strength, divine power, and leadership. It is a significant name in Christian tradition, reflecting the believer's reliance on God's strength and power.

biblical_reference.note: Imri is mentioned as the son of Ammishaddai and a leader of the tribe of Ephraim.
